card.statement:
The following commutation relations hold between the generators
of $U_{\mathbb{A}}$ . For $i,j\in I$ , $s\in\mathbb{Z}$ , $n\in\mathbb{Z}_{+}$ ,

$\displaystyle E_{i}\left[\begin{matrix}K_{j}\ ;\ s\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]$
$\displaystyle=\left[\begin{matrix}K_{j}\ ;\ s-a_{ij}\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]E_{i},$

$\displaystyle\left[\begin{matrix}K_{j}\ ;\ s\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]F_{i}$
$\displaystyle=F_{i}\left[\begin{matrix}K_{j}\ ;\ s-a_{ij}\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right],$

$\displaystyle E_{i}\left[\begin{matrix}D\ ;\ s\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]$
$\displaystyle=\left[\begin{matrix}D\ ;\ s-\delta_{i,0}\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]E_{i},$

$\displaystyle\left[\begin{matrix}D\ ;\ s\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right]F_{i}$
$\displaystyle=F_{i}\left[\begin{matrix}D\ ;\ s-\delta_{i,0}\\
\ \ n\ \end{matrix}\right],$

$\displaystyle E_{i}F_{j}$
$\displaystyle=F_{j}E_{i},\qquad\text{ for }i\neq j,$

$\displaystyle E_{i}F_{i}^{n}$
$\displaystyle=F_{i}^{n}E_{i}+F_{i}^{n-1}\sum_{r=0}^{n-1}\left[\begin{matrix}K_{i}\ ;\ -2r\\
\ \ 1\ \end{matrix}\right].$
card.label: Proposition 4.1

paper.title: Verma-type Modules for Quantum Affine Lie Algebras
paper.abstract: Let g be an untwisted affine Kac-Moody algebra and M_J(lambda) a Verma-type module for g with J-highest integral weight lambda. We construct quantum Verma-type modules M_J^q(lambda) over the quantum group U_q(g), investigate their properties and show that M_J^q(lambda) is a true quantum deformation of M_J(ł) in the sense that the weight structure is preserved under the deformation. We also analyze the submodule structure of quantum Verma-type modules.
